title: crypto/trust.py docstring still documents rejected SHA-512-native address profile
description: Found during v1kc codereview (pass 1): python/src/lichen/crypto/trust.py:12-13 documents '02xx = [0x02] || SHA-512(pubkey)[0:7] || iid' — the rejected LICHEN-native profile. Settled decision upstream-yggdrasil-addressing (spec/decisions.jsonl) mandates upstream AddrForKey everywhere; the real derivation is identity.py yggdrasil_address (AddrForKey bit-packing, no hashing). Stale doc likely contributed to the v1kc fixture bug (pin table keyed by SHA-512 IID). Update docstring to reference upstream AddrForKey.
